name: creative-writing-coach
tagline_zh: 卡在开头？人物扁平？它像贴身编辑，追问你的设定、冲突和动机，把草稿逼成有血肉的故事，还给你三版改写方向。
tagline_en: Stuck at page one? It acts like a hands-on editor, probing your setup, conflict, and motive—then hands you three.
desc_en: Helps users with creative writing and storytelling
why_zh: 同类只会给模板，它靠苏格拉底式提问逼你自省，再给具体改写路径，而非空泛建议。
why_en: Unlike template spitters, it uses Socratic questioning to force self-reflection, then offers concrete rewrite paths—not vague.
